caseName: Keatley v. United States Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Harry Wronkow Keatley v. United States Trust Company, as Executors, etc.

opinions.text: On writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. October 5, 1920. Dismissed with costs, on motion of counsel for petitioner. Mr. W. Bourfoe Cockran for petitioner. Mr. Wm. A. W. Steward, Mr. Chas. B. Fernald and Mr. Edward W. Sheldon for respondents.
